rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality, minimally cavitated early blastocyst with no clear compact ICM and poorly formed TE, broadly matching the 0DD label. Minor overreach in calling it morula-like/collapsed and not discussing zona features in detail.

Integrates age, prior failed cycles, BMI, PCOS/AMH pattern, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness well with embryo quality. Could more explicitly weigh fresh day-5 transfer context and the interaction between obesity/PCOS and implantation.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent: poor morphology drives low prognosis despite favorable age. Minor inconsistency in describing BMI as both favorable/normal relative to cutoffs and mildly adverse, and some uncertainty around grading nomenclature.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling: poor ICM/TE predicts low implantation, proceed if only embryo available, standard luteal support, no bed rest. Slight deviations include speculative comments about stimulation changes without enough cycle detail.

Provides practical counseling for transfer and sensible future workup steps (embryology review, uterine cavity assessment, sperm considerations, protocol review). Useful but somewhat generic in places and incomplete at the end.
